## 1. Executive Summary

**Almakius Felix Bariq Hekopung** (online handle: **Felix Palingan**) is an Indonesian Full-Stack Software Engineer and final-year Information Systems undergraduate at **Universitas Trisakti** (GPA: **3.72 / 4.00**, Trisakti English Proficiency Test Score: **563.33 / 677**).

He specializes in:
- **Full-Stack Web Engineering:** Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, PHP (CodeIgniter 4, Laravel), Python (Flask), RESTful APIs, and PostgreSQL / MySQL / Supabase.
- **PWA, Real-Time & Mobile Development:** Progressive Web Apps (Service Workers, Web Push/FCM), Flutter (Dart) cross-platform mobile apps, Supabase Realtime CDC WebSockets, and LiveKit Cloud SFU WebRTC audio/video streaming.
- **Creative 3D WebGL & Diegetic UI:** Three.js, custom GLSL/canvas procedural textures, GSAP camera choreography, and Web Audio API procedural sound synthesis.

## 2. Professional Experience

### Full-Stack Web Developer Intern - OK OCE Indonesia (ecsys.okoce.net / okoce.net)
- **Period:** July 2026 – December 2026
- **Location:** Jakarta, Indonesia (Hybrid / Onsite)
- **Tech Stack:** PHP 8.1+, CodeIgniter 4 (MVC), MySQL 8, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), Finpay Payment Gateway (QRIS & VA), Fonnte WhatsApp API, HTML5-QRCode, DataTables.
- **Key Engineering Achievements:**
  - **Finpay Payment Gateway & Event Ticketing:** Integrated Finpay Payment Gateway (Dynamic QRIS, Virtual Accounts), implementing secure server-side price validation, automated callbacks, persistent payment countdown timers, real-time quota validation, and automated attendance post pre-test.
  - **Database Optimization & Unbuffered Streaming:** Developed an unbuffered CSV data export engine (getUnbufferedRow) capable of streaming tens of thousands of active member records without memory exhaustion (OOM), fully compatible with regional Excel settings (semicolon delimiter, UTF-8 BOM, and safe text formula escaping).
  - **Event QR Scanner Redesign:** Modernized the field-officer Event QR Check-in scanner into a zero-scroll single-page UI with instant visual alerts (green/red feedback), drastically reducing event registration bottlenecks.
  - **WordPress to CodeIgniter 4 Migration:** Contributed to migrating enterprise WordPress content to a custom CodeIgniter 4 architecture, preserving 100% of legacy SEO routing, media assets, and canonical URLs via 301 redirects and automatic sitemap generation.
  - **Mobile-First Navigation & UX Overhaul:** Revamped the platform's navigation architecture from a 49-item flat menu into 5 structured tiers featuring a sticky thumb-friendly bottom navigation bar, drawer transitions, and real-time client-side search.
  - **Application Security Hardening:** Hardened web application security against OWASP vulnerabilities, including DataTables SQL injection mitigation, XSS sanitization (HtmlAman), and strict HTTP security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy).

  - **Algorithms & Programming:** Taught foundational Python programming, pseudocode design, and core algorithms (Binary Search, Bubble Sort, Greedy Algorithm) to 30+ first-year students.

## 3. Featured Production Projects

### 3.1. IronPixels — 16-Bit Gamified Workout Tracker & Co-Op Raid RPG
- **Live Application:** https://iron-pixels.vercel.app
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/felixpalingan/IronPixels
- **Category:** Health & Fitness Progressive Web App (PWA) / Gamified RPG
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Realtime WebSockets + Auth), Framer Motion, Web Audio API.
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - **Relative Volume Scoring (RVS):** Normalizes workout volume against user bodyweight and personal records so beginners and advanced lifters deal balanced damage in cooperative raids.
  - **Realtime Co-Op Boss Raids:** Multi-device synchronization powered by Supabase Realtime Broadcast & Presence channels.
  - **Zero-Latency Audio:** Custom procedural 8-bit/16-bit chiptune sound effects synthesized directly in the browser via the native Web Audio API.

### 3.2. Oit — High-Performance Real-Time Workspace & WebRTC Calling
- **Live Application:** https://oit-seven.vercel.app
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/felixpalingan/Oit
- **Category:** Real-Time Communication & Collaboration Platform
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase CDC, LiveKit Cloud SFU (WebRTC), Tailwind CSS v4.
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - **Sub-100ms Messaging:** Powered by Supabase Change Data Capture (CDC) WebSockets with optimistic UI updates, typing indicators, and emoji reactions.
  - **Low-Latency Voice & Video Rooms:** Integrated with LiveKit Cloud Selective Forwarding Unit (SFU) for multi-participant WebRTC audio/video streaming and screen sharing.
  - **4-Tier RBAC Security:** Granular Role-Based Access Control (Owner, Admin, Moderator, Member) enforced via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies.

### 3.3. OK OCE EventIT — National Community Event & LMS Ecosystem
- **Category:** Full-Stack Mobile & Web Event Management Platform (Capstone & Thesis Project)
- **Tech Stack:** Flutter (Dart), Python (Flask REST API), PostgreSQL, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), Flask-Mail, QR Code Digital Presence.
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Built an integrated event management and mini-LMS platform designed for OK OCE Indonesia's national entrepreneurial network.
  - Implemented encrypted OTP email registration, real-time QR code attendance validation, quantitative Pre-Test/Post-Test learning analytics, and automated H-1 push notifications via FCM.

### 3.4. Slop Dungeon — Cooperative Roguelike & Serverless WebRTC P2P
- **Live Application:** https://slop-dungeon.vercel.app
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/felixpalingan/Slop-dungeon
- **Category:** Multiplayer Roguelike Dungeon Crawler / Real-Time P2P Web Game
- **Tech Stack:** HTML5 Canvas 2D, WebRTC DataChannels (PeerJS), Web Audio API (Synthesizer), Vite 5, JavaScript (ES6+), Playwright E2E, Vitest.
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - **Serverless Peer-to-Peer:** Game state replicated across 1–6 players via WebRTC DataChannels using PeerJS signaling, eliminating dedicated server costs and achieving 60Hz host-authoritative state sync with client prediction.
  - **100% Procedural Canvas Rendering:** Zero-asset sprite sheet downloads; all monsters, characters, weapons, rooms, and particles are drawn procedurally via HTML5 Canvas 2D for instant initial load and 60+ FPS on all devices.
  - **Procedural Audio Synthesizer:** Zero external audio files; all sound effects (swords, blasts, heartbeats, gongs, coins) are synthesized at runtime via oscillators, gain nodes, and noise buffers using the Web Audio API.
  - **Modular Anime Equipment & Ultimates:** 54+ procedural items across 5 rarity tiers unlocking screen-clearing cinematic abilities (Hollow Purple, World Cutting Slash, Berserker Rage) and shared party economy with gacha altar mechanics.

### 3.5. Megabuilding H10 Room 1214 — 3D WebGL Cyberpunk Portfolio
- **Live Application:** https://portfolio-felix-bariq.vercel.app/
- **Tech Stack:** Three.js (WebGL), Vite, GSAP, HTML5 Canvas 2D Diegetic UI, Web Audio API.
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Completely procedural 3D apartment scene inspired by Cyberpunk 2077, built without heavy external `.glb` bottlenecks for fast initial load and 60 FPS desktop/mobile performance.
  - Triple-monitor Netrunner workstation rendered dynamically onto 2D HTML5 canvases mapped as `THREE.CanvasTexture` materials with UV raycast hitboxes.
